mobbin:024a7f32-0ecc-4767-9123-0fb0830f2.summary: The host opens Scan to Check In, confirms a scanned guest on a panel, then gets a green success message while the scanner stays ready for the next person.
steps: Scan to Check In: viewfinder and List or Scan
Guest panel: name, status Going, Check In
Green message: Guest checked in; scan stays open
steal: A confirm-before-commit guest panel with name, email and status before Check In (screen 2) prevents wrong roster tags.
A green success message without leaving the scanner (screen 3) keeps throughput for a line of learners.
A List or Scan control plus search shortcut (screen 1) gives a QR fail path without abandoning the flow.
A flashlight control on the scan chrome (screen 1) helps in poorly lit rooms.
avoid: Do not tag this as equipment check. The screens only show guest ticket check-in, not room or device setup.
mobbin:024a7f32-0ecc-4767-9123-0fb0830f2.fit: Mobile and iPad app: mobile beats desktop for door-side learner tagging. QR scan plus one-tap confirm replaces paper roster or SRV search. The same pattern maps to room QR for equipment check, but this flow itself is people only.

mobbin:26b0f3ea-2156-43d2-b580-f4774fbb7.summary: From an event card the host opens Check In, scans a guest, confirms identity, then can Undo Check In after success.
steps: Event card: Invite, Check In, Blast, More
Camera scan: viewfinder, list, flip camera
Guest panel: Jason Smith, Check In
Success: Check In Successful and Undo Check In
steal: Check In is a first-class action on the session or event card (screen 1), not buried in settings.
A confirm panel before commit (screen 3) shows name, status Going and ticket type.
Undo Check In on the success panel (screen 4) recovers fast from an accidental scan.
A flip-camera control on the scanner (screen 2) supports front or rear for badge versus phone-held QR.
mobbin:26b0f3ea-2156-43d2-b580-f4774fbb7.fit: Mobile and iPad app: phone in hand at the room door beats TouchPro-only tagging. Extends baseline learner tagging and QR checklist with undo and confirm.
